answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: rewards an identity earns are escrowed and released slowly, like a vine creeping up a trellis, and any slashing event before release forfeits the unvested balance. An attacker running a thousand accounts must keep each one doing honest, verified work for weeks, and one detected mirror account (copying another's output) burns its whole locked pile. The lotus-slow payout turns fake identities into a costly, illiquid bet instead of quick profit.
